source: Direct user instruction in project chat
raw_user_statement: I should also mention. My expert who will assemble the parts - I don't anticipate he'll contribute new expert measurements. I should be tasked with that to the extent that it's required, but I plan on really belaboring that I found this difficult and should only do it for a handful of critical measurements to the extent they're really absolutely needed for the machining of our escutcheon plate and no more.
expert_role: Assembly, necessary installation adjustments and ordinary fit/function/sealing checks. Do not plan on the expert supplying a new dimensional survey or CAD measurement dataset.
owner_role: Only the indispensable new measurements needed to determine the custom main or diverter plate machining geometry, if any remain after using the existing evidence.
burden_constraint: Measurement has been difficult. Request at most a handful, in one short prioritized batch. No general remeasurement campaign or measurements merely to improve a scan/model.
request_gate: Identify the specific machining feature or decision that the value changes, such as aperture size, outer profile, thickness or an essential locator.
Explain why accepted measurements, manufacturer references, existing scans or a simpler design cannot resolve that feature adequately.
Show the exact physical contacts, reference plane and measurement direction in a clear annotated view; give an easy method and only the precision actually needed.
State how the reading changes the CAD and which dependent step is blocked without it; continue unaffected quote/trial work.
If no further dimension is indispensable for the selected machining scope, say so and request none.
design_preference: Prefer a sensible broad aperture without optional fixed bolt locators if adding locators creates avoidable measurement burden. Do not invent missing geometry or loosen a functional requirement merely to avoid asking.
installation_distinction: Ordinary assembly and fit/water checks remain necessary, but are not a new pre-machining metrology assignment. Existing long field forms are optional recording aids, not mandatory measuring lists for either person.
